name: Nango
summary: Integration layer that gives agents and products auth, tool-calling actions, syncs and webhooks across 1,000+ APIs, including MCP auth and a management MCP.
description: Integrations are code-owned functions. Docs cover agent tool calling, MCP Auth (users connect to MCP servers through Nango), a Management MCP, and scoped agent sessions that replace the earlier Connection MCP. Pricing: Free $0/month with hard-capped limits, Pay-as-you-go $50/month in credits ($0.29/connection, $0.72/compute hour, $0.5/GB), Enterprise custom with self-hosting. The repo is under the Elastic License 2.0.
